Name: Ginger Island World Map Fix - No Valley Preview and Dynamic Area Names
Author: ShenXL192168
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Adds dynamic area names to the Ginger Island world map based on the player's current location. The displayed map name will automatically change between [b]Ginger Island, Ginger Island South, Ginger Island North, Ginger Island East, and Ginger Island Southeast[/b] as you travel around the island.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51938/51938-1788894793-977386338.png[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51938/51938-1788894803-1009124771.png[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51938/51938-1788894808-762931807.png[/img]

When using the mod [b]" [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24210?tab=files]World Maps everywhere at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url] "[/b], the different world maps can be viewed as separate maps. The original Ginger Island preview embedded in the Valley map therefore feels somewhat out of place. This mod hides that preview and removes the corresponding NPC/player markers from the Valley map, while keeping Ginger Island fully functional as its own independent world map. Together with the new dynamic area names, this provides a cleaner, more unified, and consistent world map experience.

[compare before=https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51938/51938-1788880114-1152893500.png]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51938/51938-1788880117-1515250762.png[/compare]


It is recommended to pair this with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51940]星露谷物语Nexus上的RSV世界地图尺寸变更——模组与社区[/url] mod, which changes the RSV map from its original size to match the size of the main map, achieving a unified and consistent map style display.

[s][b][color=#ff0000]Due to my limited proficiency, the dynamic area names added to the Ginger Island map are currently available in Chinese only. Users playing in other languages can manually replace the Chinese text with the corresponding names in their own language by editing the   [/color][/b][size=2][font=Monaco, Menlo, Consolas, monospace][color=#00ff00][b][i]content.json[/i][/b] [/color]  [/font][/size][/s][b][s][color=#ff0000]file. [/color][/s][color=#ffffff] Now supports i18n. [/color][/b]
